title: ebi-metagenomics/mettannotator pipeline - params.input schema
description: Schema for the file provided with params.input

prefix.errorMessage: Prefix, used for the gene names.

assembly.errorMessage: The assembly needs to be a fasta file.

taxid.errorMessage: NCBI taxid should only contain digits.

gene_calls_gff.errorMessage: gene_calls_gff must be a path ending in .gff or .gff3, or left empty.
gene_calls_gff.description: Optional path to an external GFF/GFF3 file for this sample. When provided, Prokka/Bakta gene calling is skipped.

gene_calls_faa.errorMessage: gene_calls_faa must be a path ending in .faa, or left empty.
gene_calls_faa.description: Optional path to a protein FASTA (.faa) matching the external GFF. Required when gene_calls_gff is provided.

gene_calls_gbk.errorMessage: gene_calls_gbk must be a path ending in .gbk, or left empty.
gene_calls_gbk.description: Optional GenBank file for external gene call samples with prokka/bakta annotation source. Enables Pseudofinder, GECCO, antiSMASH, and SanntiS for those samples.

annotation_source.description: Annotation source for external gene calls: prokka, bakta, or ensembl. Required when gene_calls_gff is provided.
